notes.title: Playtest Time!
notes.content: [p][b]Heya, Alex here! [/b]ːsteamhappyː[/p][p]We would like to express our infinite gratitude for being interested in our game![/p][p][/p][p]As you can see, we’re now in the middle of a game testing process. We’ve already asked our mates and significant others to help us, and now it’s your turn![/p][p]We've granted access to [i][u]30 random people[/u][/i], so that they can help us to improve the game before the release![/p][p]The business is serious, that's why we would like the lucky ones to test it with full dedication and an open heart. Most importantly, to fill the [url="https://forms.gle/AFGY7qMjt23HceSX7"]Feedback Form[/url] as informatively as possible. The deadline is about [u][i]a week[/i][/u] at best![/p][p][/p][p][b]IMPORTANT:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Our team will give you great respect, if you provide a video playthrough of the game! You can use any convenient cloud storage and attach the link in the [url="https://forms.gle/y2dV6r3subTnznyF6"]Feedback Form[/url]. [b][i]Don't forget to give access to your file![/i][/b][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]The game is designed to be played by [u][i]2 people[/i][/u], so you need to find someone you're ready to play with[/p][/*][*][p][u][i]Steam Remote[/i][/u] is available, so you can play online with your mates[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Thank you for your service![/p]
